title: A finitely generated field extension has a finite transcendence basis
statement: Let $K/k$ be a finitely generated field extension [def-pc-field-extension], i.e. $K=k(a_1,\dots,a_n)$ for finitely many $a_1,\dots,a_n\in K$. Then $K/k$ has a finite transcendence basis [def-weil-pbc-transcendence-basis]: there are $r\ge0$ and $x_1,\dots,x_r\in K$ algebraically independent over $k$ such that $K$ is algebraic over $k(x_1,\dots,x_r)$.

source.place: Fields, Lemma Tag 030F (lemma-transcendence-degree, line 3398), existence part and its proof (a transcendence basis B with B contained in any generating set G; G = {a_1,...,a_n} finite gives B finite)
